sentences.ar: كلهم عرفوا مين اللي عمل هالشغلة.
sentences.en: They all knew who had done this.

sentences.ar: أم الأسد إجت وحكت لابنها كل إشي.
sentences.en: The lion’s mother came and told her son everything.
Dimna was imprisoned and tried before them all.

sentences.ar: قال دمنة: أنا حكيت كلام بس.
sentences.en: Dimna said: I only spoke words.

sentences.ar: قال القاضي: والكلام بيقتل زي السيف.
sentences.en: The judge said: and words kill like a sword.

sentences.ar: كليلة مات من الحزن على أخوه.
sentences.en: Kalila died of grief over his brother.
